title: Exceptionnel
text:
An unforgettable experience!
We rented bikes and participated in a guided tour with my friends, which was simply exceptional from start to finish! The bikes🚲 were in excellent condition, comfortable and suitable for all levels. The shop staff was friendly, attentive and gave us great advice😁.
I highly recommend it!
author: H3496FTgiovannil

title: Best way to get an overview of the city
text: This was the best. We loved seeing the sights while biking throughout the city. Our tour guide had photographs of all of the sights so that she could stop and explain some of the details. It was really effective. She was captivating and had great stories to share with us about Barcelona and how it developed.
author: Amy_C

title: Great Bike Ride
text: Wonderful tour through the beach area as well as historic areas of Barcelona.  Very interesting and an easy ride suitable for anyone.
author: kerris229

title: Great bike tour of the city
text: Very nice afternoon with our companion Mady who guided us through the avenues and small streets of Barcelona. Our journey allowed us to see the most important monuments with interesting anecdotes. Cycling around the city is a very good option when you are on a weekend and have only 2 days to visit. I recommend that anyone who wants to learn as much as possible about Barcelona and its flagship artist: Gaudi.
author: mcss879

title: Great tour of Barcelona
text: Great tour to get an overview of Barcelona, from the seaside to Sagrada Familia and other Gaudi buildings with a friendly guide :)
author: SelinaR180

title: The blue bicycle
text: The bike tour of Barcelona with our guide Corentin was great! A great guide who knows how to wonderfully tell the history of Barcelona through the ages and anecdotes! A nugget this Corentin ☺️👌🏻
